subject.title: Bug: Billing error (402) causes infinite retry death spiral for inline-apiKey providers (no backoff)

question: Should OpenClaw adopt provider-level persisted cooldown state for inline `models.providers.<id>.apiKey` credentials, including fail-closed behavior during auth/billing windows?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the fix creates durable auth-provider behavior and a provider-level usage identity for existing inline-key configurations.

options.title: Accept provider-level cooldown
options.body: Land or rebuild the linked fix so inline keys get billing/auth cooldown protection while healthy stored profiles can still be used as fallback.

options.title: Keep profile-only cooldowns
options.body: Document migration from inline API keys to auth profiles as the supported workaround and close the implementation path as not planned.

options.title: Request a narrower design
options.body: Pause the linked PR until maintainers specify the exact cooldown identity, persistence, and recovery behavior for inline credentials.

recommendation.title: Accept provider-level cooldown
recommendation.body: Land or rebuild the linked fix so inline keys get billing/auth cooldown protection while healthy stored profiles can still be used as fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest available routing candidate from adjacent auth/provider history and prior issue routing for this compatibility choice.
